Use a Reaction to give an ally 2 Boons against a physical attack, then push an attacker adjacent to that ally 2 squares away.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible willing ally within 3 squares, before it defends against a physical attack.
Type
Magic / Defense / Control

The ally gains 2 Boons to the defense. After the attack resolves, push an attacker adjacent to that ally 2 squares directly away from it.
